answers.description: Wholesale and retail bakery in Todmorden. Sourdough, tin loaves and buns for cafés and farm shops across Calderdale, delivered before 7am from Tuesday to Saturday.

hero.subhead: We bake sourdough, tin loaves and buns for cafés and farm shops across Calderdale, delivered fresh each morning.

items.description: Proper sourdough baked each morning for cafés and farm shops who want the real thing.
Tin loaves and buns baked fresh, ready for your shelves before opening time.
Regular wholesale baking for cafés and farm shops across Calderdale.

services.heading: We bake bread for cafés and farm shops across Calderdale.

about.statement: We bake because good bread brings people together, and Calderdale's cafés and farm shops deserve it fresh.

items.question: What kind of bread do you bake?
items.answer: We bake sourdough, tin loaves and buns for cafés and farm shops who want proper bread each morning.

items.question: When does delivery arrive?
items.answer: Every order reaches you before seven, Tuesday to Saturday, so your shelves are ready for opening time.

items.question: Do you do wholesale and retail?
items.answer: Whether you need regular wholesale orders or smaller retail amounts, we bake to suit your shop.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Tell us what you need, whether that's sourdough, tin loaves or buns, and how often you'd like deliveries.

items.question: How do you plan our order?
items.answer: We work out quantities and timings together, so your order fits your shop and your customers.

items.question: Which days do you deliver?
items.answer: Your bread arrives before seven each morning, Tuesday to Saturday, ready for your day ahead.
